# Primary

> > Primary offers gender-neutral kids' clothing in vibrant colors and essential basics for babies through size 14, focusing on quality, comfort, and sustainable materials.

Primary specializes in simple, colorful children's apparel without logos or slogans, featuring organic cotton options, FlexKnit performance fabrics, and thoughtful design details like bump-free seams and color-coded sizing. The site offers both everyday essentials and seasonal collections with frequent clearance opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Gender-neutral clothing
- Kids basics and essentials
- Baby clothing (0-24 months)
- Organic cotton options
- FlexKnit performance fabric
- Seasonal colors and patterns
- Clearance items
- Mini stripe and rainbow stripe patterns
- Kids pajamas and sleepwear
- Bundle packs (2-pack, 6-pack)
- UPF 50+ sun protection
- Sustainable children's apparel
- Mix-and-match separates
- Color-coded sizing
- Flame-resistant sleepwear
